title: Consensus ensemble rerank eval and A/B instrumentation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: build a reproducible evaluation harness and A/B instrumentation to measure the impact of a consensus ensemble that combines embedding-similarity signals and a learned neural reranker. Focus: quality (NDCG@10, MRR@10), tail latency (p95/p99 for rerank endpoint), and scaling behavior under mixed workloads. Scope includes: 1) offline eval pipeline for customer prompt sets, with stratified sampling and bias-corrected NDCG/MRR; 2) production-safe A/B hooks that route live traffic slices to ensemble variants and record deterministic scoring traces; 3) lightweight latency-budgeting middleware to enforce p95 targets and fallback policies; 4) dashboards and automated alerts for regressions. Outcome: a validated rollout path for the ensemble model with clear guardrails (quality uplift > 3% NDCG@10 on held-out customers OR MRR improvement without >10% latency degradation), and reproducible artifacts to support sales/CS questions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Offline harness runs end-to-end on at least 3 representative customer prompt sets and publishes NDCG@10 and MRR@10 with confidence intervals. 2) A/B instrumentation implemented in rerank service; logs include request_id, variant, proto inputs, top-K scatter of scores, and latency buckets. 3) Canary rollout succeeds on 5% traffic with automated rollback if NDCG delta < -1% or p95 latency > SLO by 20%. 4) Grafana dashboard shows per-customer NDCG/MRR slices, and an Alert in PagerDuty if regression thresholds tripped. 5) PRs and runbooks merged and a short demo recorded for Solutions Engineering.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (offline): run ensemble on historical prompt sets, iterate on feature weights and ensemble combiner (Feb). Phase 2 (canary): deploy ensemble behind feature flag to 5% traffic with A/B hooks and latency budget middleware (Mar). Phase 3 (scale): increase to 25% after 72h of stable metrics, then full rollout with automated rollback if alerts fire (Apr). Maintain a 2-week observation window for model quality drift checks and add scheduled monthly replayed-eval runs.
